verdict.rationale: Hosting downloadable forms and instructions without an account is a fair question for a government immigration agency's site, so the axis applies. The only evidence is a probe whose TLS connection failed, so nothing on the host was fetched. Earlier reachability of robots.txt and the landing page says nothing about forms or instructions being available, so there is no evidence of the capability.

support.subject: As a founder, the forms themselves and their instructions are downloadable from the service's site without an account
